title: Evidence-backed research pack
goal: Turn an approved public dataset into an editable report, CSV workbook and presentation outline.
acceptanceCriteria: Every numeric claim traces to an input row

title: Public software improvement
goal: Implement a bounded feature or performance improvement in an approved open-source project.
acceptanceCriteria: Acceptance tests pass on the declared revision
A reviewer can reproduce the change

title: Browser acceptance suite
goal: Exercise approved application flows and return reproducible bug reports and tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Coverage maps to the approved flows
Failures and blocked steps are disclosed

title: Public dataset cleanup
goal: Normalize a public or synthetic dataset while preserving its provenance.

title: Public product comparison
goal: Compare public product documentation against a buyer-approved feature matrix.
acceptanceCriteria: Every comparison cites a dated source
No private or personal data collected

title: Energy scenario analysis
goal: Model a public energy dataset and compare explicit assumptions.
acceptanceCriteria: No physical-system control or geoengineering execution

title: Public literature evidence map
goal: Organize approved public research sources into a traceable evidence table.
acceptanceCriteria: No diagnosis or clinical decision execution

title: Executable technical guide
goal: Build a guide with examples that run on a declared environment.
acceptanceCriteria: All commands run from a clean setup

title: Accessible interface prototype
goal: Create an interactive prototype against an approved brief and public or licensed assets.

title: Numerical reproduction
goal: Reproduce a published computation using public data and explicit tolerances.
acceptanceCriteria: Results meet agreed tolerances or disclose discrepancies
Independent reviewer can rerun the calculation
